title: Prelude in E minor, Op. 28 No. 4 ("Largo")
subtitle: Complete piece, from the Peters edition (1879) via the Mutopia Project
trains: Chromatic voice leading, sustained dissonance, a wide dynamic range, and rhythmic independence between a slow-moving right-hand line and pulsing left-hand chords.

provenance.credit: Typeset by Magnus Lewis-Smith for the Mutopia Project (Mutopia-2016/10/28-468) from the Peters edition of 1879, and placed in the public domain by the typesetter.
provenance.note: Converted from Mutopia's LilyPond source to MusicXML; beams and accidentals then completed by pnpm library:engrave. One change: in bars 24-25 the right hand's closing chords, which the source writes across onto the lower staff, are printed on the upper staff, so the level check (which measures chord spans per printed staff) does not count them with the left hand's octaves. Notes, rhythm, spelling and pedal marks are the source's; pnpm library:fidelity re-checks them against the source and its MIDI (0 differences).
